extDescription.message: Detects ClickFix-style social engineering (fake CAPTCHA plus Win+R/Terminal paste lures) and warns before a pasted command is run.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser.

bannerWarning.message: Warning: this page shows signs of a ClickFix-style attack. If you copied a code from a verification prompt here, do not paste it anywhere. Report it to your security team.
bannerWarning.description: Text of the interstitial banner shown when the score crosses the threshold.

bannerDismiss.description: Accessible label for the banner close button.

bannerAllowlistButton.description: Label for the banner button that adds the site to the allow list.

bannerAllowlistConfirm.message: Add $HOST$ to your permanent allow list? ClickFix Guard will never warn on this site again after this. Only confirm if you're sure this warning is a false positive.
bannerAllowlistConfirm.description: Confirmation dialog shown before adding to the allow list.

bannerAllowlistAdded.message: $HOST$ was added to the allow list.
bannerAllowlistAdded.description: Brief confirmation shown in the banner after allowlisting.

popupEmpty.description: Shown in the popup when the log is empty.

popupScore.description: Label preceding the numeric score in a popup log entry.

popupAllowlistTitle.description: Heading for the section listing sites added to the allow list via the banner button.

bannerAllowlistRejected.message: This site can't be trusted from here. If you think this warning is wrong, ask your security team to review it.
bannerAllowlistRejected.description: Shown in the banner when the policy doesn't allow trusting this site.

popupPolicyBuiltin.message: Built-in defaults (no settings from your organization)
popupPolicyBuiltin.description: Popup footer when no Admin console policy is set.

popupPolicyManaged.description: Popup footer when the Admin console policy is in effect.

popupPolicyIgnored.description: Popup footer listing Admin console entries that were invalid.
